question: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.
event_verification_notes: The Corridor Agreement, which facilitated grain exports from Orvan, expired on 10 September 2026 without a renewal, as confirmed by official notices from the Realm Trade Ministry and news reports. An initial report of a renewal was corrected and retracted by the source.

event_citations.quote: The Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026.
The agreement expired on 10 September without a renewal.
The agreement was signed on 10 September 2025 and ran for one year.
It expired on 10 September without a replacement.

missing_data: Monthly trade volume and value for Orvan to Tolan maize imports (2025-2026).
Quantitative monthly data for alternative Vanir exports and Ravik rail loadings to Midgard and Tolan.
As-of date grain stock levels for Midgard and Tolan to determine economic buffer.
corrections: ORV-0013 correction of ORV-0043: Raven Wire retracted its report that the corridor agreement was renewed, stating the agreement expired without a signed replacement.
